seoTitle: How to Copy From Google Slides to Google Docs (2026)
metaDescription: Move text and slides from Google Slides into Google Docs, and use the Link to Presentation option so edits sync automatically between both files.
intro: Pulling content from a presentation into a written report doesn't have to mean retyping everything. This guide covers copying static text and graphics between the two apps, plus using the Link to Presentation option so your embedded slide stays connected to the source and updates automatically when you make changes later.

steps.heading: Select your source content
steps.body: In Google Slides, select the text sequences, outline blocks, or individual slide shapes you want to bring into your document.

steps.heading: Copy and switch to Google Docs
steps.body: Copy your selection, then move to your active Google Docs canvas where you want the content to appear.

steps.heading: Paste and choose linking options
steps.body: Paste your content and review whether to keep it as a static image or establish a live link back to the presentation.

steps.heading: Enable Link to Presentation
steps.body: Choose the Link to presentation parameter to create a dynamic connection that lets you pull real-time edits with a single Update click.

steps.heading: Adjust text wrap and positioning
steps.body: Format your imported slide's text wrap and margin positioning so it aligns cleanly within your document's text grid.

steps.heading: Disconnect the link when finalized
steps.body: Break the cloud link once your document is finished to lock the slide elements into a permanent, independent graphic file.

faq.question: What happens if I edit the slide after pasting it into Docs?
faq.answer: If you used the Link to presentation option, an Update button appears in your document letting you pull in the latest changes with one click.

faq.question: Can I paste just plain text instead of a full slide image?
faq.answer: Yes, standard copy-and-paste of text sequences brings in editable text rather than a static slide image.

faq.question: How do I stop my Google Doc from updating automatically?
faq.answer: Disconnect the presentation link through the linked object's options to freeze it as a static, independent element.

faq.question: Will formatting stay consistent when I paste slide content into a document?
faq.answer: Mostly, though you may need to adjust text wrapping and margins so the imported content fits your document's layout properly.
